indicators.label: Population, 2023
indicators.definition: Persons enumerated in the 2023 census (headline count).

indicators.label: Population, 2017
indicators.definition: 2017 census population, as re-tabulated by PBS on 2023 district boundaries.

indicators.label: Annual population growth, 2017-2023
indicators.definition: Compound annual growth between the 2017 and 2023 counts over a six-year interval.

indicators.label: Area
indicators.definition: Area reported by PBS.

indicators.label: Population density
indicators.definition: Population divided by reported area.

indicators.label: Urban population share
indicators.definition: Share of the population living in areas PBS classifies as urban.

indicators.label: Sex ratio
indicators.definition: Males per 100 females.

indicators.label: Persons per household
indicators.definition: Population divided by the number of households in Tables 22-25. PBS publishes 6.33 nationally but does not state its method in these tables, so expect small differences from PBS's figures.

indicators.label: Literacy rate (10+)
indicators.definition: Literate persons aged 10 and over as a share of all persons aged 10 and over.

indicators.label: Female literacy rate (10+)
indicators.definition: Literate women and girls aged 10 and over as a share of all women and girls aged 10 and over.

indicators.label: Male literacy rate (10+)
indicators.definition: Literate men and boys aged 10 and over as a share of all men and boys aged 10 and over.

indicators.label: Literacy gender gap
indicators.definition: Male minus female literacy rate (10+). Positive means men are ahead.

indicators.label: Out-of-school children (5-16)
indicators.definition: Children aged 5-16 who never attended school or dropped out, as a share of all children aged 5-16.

indicators.label: Out-of-school girls (5-16)
indicators.definition: Girls aged 5-16 who never attended school or dropped out, as a share of all girls aged 5-16.

indicators.label: Out-of-school boys (5-16)
indicators.definition: Boys aged 5-16 who never attended school or dropped out, as a share of all boys aged 5-16.

indicators.label: Persons with a disability
indicators.definition: Persons reported with a disability as a share of the population covered by Table 16.

indicators.label: Households lit by grid electricity
indicators.definition: Households whose main source of lighting is electricity.

indicators.label: Households lit by solar
indicators.definition: Households whose main source of lighting is solar.

indicators.label: Households cooking with piped gas
indicators.definition: Households whose main cooking fuel is natural gas.

indicators.label: Households cooking with firewood
indicators.definition: Households whose main cooking fuel is firewood.

indicators.label: Improved drinking water
indicators.definition: Households whose main drinking-water source PBS classifies as improved.

indicators.label: Drinking water on premises
indicators.definition: Households whose drinking-water source is inside the dwelling or compound.

indicators.label: Households with a flush toilet
indicators.definition: Households with a flush toilet.

indicators.label: Households with no toilet
indicators.definition: Households with no toilet facility.

indicators.label: Pakka (permanent) housing
indicators.definition: Households living in pakka (fired brick or concrete) structures.

indicators.label: Households renting
indicators.definition: Households living in a rented dwelling.

indicators.label: Households in one room
indicators.definition: Households living in a dwelling with a single room.

indicators.label: Dwellings owned by women
indicators.definition: Share of privately held dwellings (owner-occupied, rented or rent-free) whose owner is a woman. Table 25 reports owner's sex for exactly these three tenure types.
